name: learning-team-facilitator
questions: What is the session's scope? (Recommended) one activity the work-as-done evidence covers, such as the emergency isolation or the job before the event; one cluster (a function, for example Operations); one learning from the register (LR-nn); or unknown (the top prompts across the export)

Who will be in the room, by roles only? (Recommended) the people who do the work (for example field operators, the control-room operator, a maintenance technician), with one facilitator who did not investigate; add a supervisor only if the team agrees; or unknown (plan for 5 to 8 workers by role)
